eyebrow: A postponed federal deadline runs out this week
sub: 24 counties and 25 tribal nations. Automatic for an IRS address of record.

title: Who is covered, and how it applies

rows.label: COVERED AREA
rows.note: The full list is the one in IRS relief notice WA-2025-03.

rows.label: HOW IT APPLIES
rows.note: The IRS identifies taxpayers whose address of record sits in the area.

rows.label: COVERS FROM
rows.value: Federal returns and payments due on or after Dec 9, 2025

callout.label: This case needs a phone call
callout.body: A client outside the area whose records or preparer are inside it is not covered automatically — call IRS Special Services on 866-562-5227. Firms holding records for ten or more clients can use the bulk request route.

title: Read the banner, not the body

rows.label: THE UPDATE BANNER
rows.value: Deadline moved May 1 → Aug 5, and the area was expanded

rows.label: THE BODY BELOW IT
rows.value: Still says May 1, still lists the original 17 entries
rows.note: The IRS never rewrote the body. Read it alone and you are three months stale and short eight counties.

callout.label: One more trap
callout.body: Samish appears among those 17 entries. It is the Samish Indian Nation — Washington has no Samish County.
